newsitem.title: CANADA: Westaim names Jenkins as president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Westaim names Jenkins as president, CEO.

text.p: Westaim Corp said on Monday that its board appointed Kevin Jenkins as president and chief executive, effective immediately.
Jenkins resigned from his previous position as president and chief executive of Canadian Airlines Corp in June.
Westaim, a new Alberta-based advanced industrial materials company, said Jenkins joined the company as it began to take some products to the marketplace.
"The company is on the threshold of its most dynamic chapter and it will benefit from (Jenkins') demonstrated leadership," said Westaim chairman Ian Delaney.
